sentence: This project builds crystals made from protein and DNA that can hold other molecules in a repeating pattern so their structures can be found.
This project builds a robotic and computer system that uses artificial intelligence to find the structures of molecules from electron diffraction data.
This project builds a computer cluster to support hands-on work with generative artificial intelligence, including diffusion models and large language models.
This project builds artificial intelligence that turns satellite imagery into maps of underwater depth for coastlines, rivers, and lakes.
This project builds machine learning methods that find short-term actions, long-term decision-making and interactions between animals in days of video recordings.
This project builds methods that use gas-phase reactions to tell apart subtle differences in the chemical structures of lipids and metabolites.
This project studies why deep learning makes accurate predictions on unseen scenarios, using theoretical analysis and empirical evaluation.
This project studies how whole genome duplication changes the climatic niche of flowering plants by linking genotypes, phenotypes and environment.
This project compares genomes of great apes and monkeys to find out how mutation and recombination rates change and what drives them.
This project brings together researchers to share their work in experimental mathematics and tools such as 3D printing and cloud computing.
This project builds a fast method that estimates hidden physical properties from noisy measurements and gives reliable estimates of uncertainty.
This project uses x-ray pulses to measure how fast an electron is ejected from a molecule hit by a light pulse.
This project brings data science and bioinformatics into the science curriculum.
This project studies wave patterns that build up from many isolated traveling waves called solitons, using mathematics to describe their behavior.
